<?php
const RESERVED = "SELECT DISTINCT FROM AS JOIN INNER LEFT OUTER ON WHERE GROUP BY HAVING ORDER ASC DESC LIMIT OFFSET INSERT INTO VALUES UPDATE SET DELETE CREATE TABLE DROP PRIMARY KEY NOT NULL INT TEXT AND OR IS IN BETWEEN LIKE COUNT SUM MIN MAX AVG EXIT";
const AGGREGATES = ["COUNT", "SUM", "MIN", "MAX", "AVG"];
const COMPARISONS = ["=", "<>", "!=", "<", "<=", ">", ">="];
final class SqlError extends Exception {}
function fail(string $s): never
{
    throw new SqlError($s);
}
final class Expr
{
    public ?string $table = null;
    public string $column = "",
        $text = "";
    public int $index = -1;
    public bool $distinct = false,
        $negated = false;
    public function __construct(
        public string $kind,
        public string $op = "",
        public array $args = [],
        public int|string|null $value = null,
    ) {}
}
function tokenize(string $text): array
{
    $reserved = array_flip(explode(" ", RESERVED));
    $tokens = [];
    $i = 0;
    while ($i < strlen($text)) {
        $rest = substr($text, $i);
        if (preg_match('/^(?:[ \n]+|--[^\n]*)/', $rest, $m)) {
            $i += strlen($m[0]);
            continue;
        }
        if (preg_match("/^'([^']*)'/", $rest, $m)) {
            $kind = "string";
            $value = $m[1];
        } elseif (preg_match("/^[0-9]+/", $rest, $m)) {
            $kind = "integer";
            $value = (int) $m[0];
        } elseif (preg_match("/^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*/", $rest, $m)) {
            $upper = strtoupper($m[0]);
            $kind = isset($reserved[$upper]) ? "keyword" : "name";
            $value = $kind === "keyword" ? $upper : $m[0];
        } elseif (preg_match("/^(?:<>|!=|<=|>=|\|\||[(),.;*\/%+\-=<>])/", $rest, $m)) {
            $kind = "symbol";
            $value = $m[0];
        } else {
            fail("unexpected character '" . $text[$i] . "'");
        }
        $tokens[] = ["kind" => $kind, "value" => $value, "text" => $m[0]];
        $i += strlen($m[0]);
    }
    return $tokens;
}
final class Parser
{
    private int $position = 0;
    public function __construct(private array $tokens) {}
    private function peek(): array
    {
        return $this->tokens[$this->position];
    }
    private function take(): array
    {
        return $this->tokens[$this->position++];
    }
    private function at(string $word): bool
    {
        $t = $this->peek();
        return in_array($t["kind"], ["symbol", "keyword"], true) && $t["value"] === $word;
    }
    private function accept(string $word): bool
    {
        if (!$this->at($word)) {
            return false;
        }
        $this->position++;
        return true;
    }
    private function syntax(): never
    {
        fail("syntax error at '" . $this->peek()["text"] . "'");
    }
    private function expect(string $word): void
    {
        if (!$this->accept($word)) {
            $this->syntax();
        }
    }
    private function kind(string $kind): mixed
    {
        if ($this->peek()["kind"] !== $kind) {
            $this->syntax();
        }
        return $this->take()["value"];
    }
    private function comma(Closure $read): array
    {
        $a = [$read()];
        while ($this->accept(",")) {
            $a[] = $read();
        }
        return $a;
    }
    private function parens(Closure $read): array
    {
        $this->expect("(");
        $a = $this->comma($read);
        $this->expect(")");
        return $a;
    }
    private function alias(): ?string
    {
        if ($this->accept("AS")) {
            return $this->kind("name");
        }
        return $this->peek()["kind"] === "name" ? $this->take()["value"] : null;
    }
    private function table(): array
    {
        $name = $this->kind("name");
        return ["name" => $name, "alias" => $this->alias() ?? $name];
    }
    private function reference(): Expr
    {
        $name = $this->kind("name");
        $e = new Expr("ref");
        if ($this->accept(".")) {
            $e->table = $name;
            $e->column = $this->kind("name");
            $e->text = $name . "." . $e->column;
        } else {
            $e->text = $e->column = $name;
        }
        return $e;
    }
    private function expression(int $level = 0): Expr
    {
        if ($level === 2 && $this->accept("NOT")) {
            return new Expr("unary", "NOT", [$this->expression(2)]);
        }
        if ($level === 6 && $this->accept("-")) {
            return new Expr("unary", "-", [$this->expression(6)]);
        }
        if ($level === 7) {
            return $this->primary();
        }
        $left = $this->expression($level + 1);
        if ($level === 3) {
            if (
                $this->peek()["kind"] === "symbol" &&
                in_array($this->peek()["value"], COMPARISONS, true)
            ) {
                $op = $this->take()["value"];
                return new Expr("binary", $op, [$left, $this->expression(4)]);
            }
            if ($this->accept("IS")) {
                $neg = $this->accept("NOT");
                $this->expect("NULL");
                $e = new Expr("isnull", "", [$left]);
                $e->negated = $neg;
                return $e;
            }
            $neg = $this->accept("NOT");
            $e = null;
            if ($this->accept("IN")) {
                $e = new Expr("in", "", [$left, ...$this->parens(fn() => $this->expression())]);
            } elseif ($this->accept("BETWEEN")) {
                $low = $this->expression(4);
                $this->expect("AND");
                $e = new Expr("between", "", [$left, $low, $this->expression(4)]);
            } elseif ($this->accept("LIKE")) {
                $e = new Expr("like", "", [$left, $this->expression(4)]);
            } elseif ($neg) {
                $this->syntax();
            }
            if ($e) {
                $e->negated = $neg;
                return $e;
            }
            return $left;
        }
        $ops = [
            0 => ["OR"],
            1 => ["AND"],
            2 => [],
            4 => ["+", "-", "||"],
            5 => ["*", "/", "%"],
            6 => [],
        ][$level];
        while (
            in_array($this->peek()["kind"], ["keyword", "symbol"], true) &&
            in_array($this->peek()["value"], $ops, true)
        ) {
            $op = $this->take()["value"];
            $left = new Expr("binary", $op, [$left, $this->expression($level + 1)]);
        }
        return $left;
    }
    private function primary(): Expr
    {
        $t = $this->peek();
        if (in_array($t["kind"], ["integer", "string"], true)) {
            $this->take();
            return new Expr("literal", value: $t["value"]);
        }
        if ($this->accept("NULL")) {
            return new Expr("literal");
        }
        if ($t["kind"] === "name") {
            return $this->reference();
        }
        if ($t["kind"] === "keyword" && in_array($t["value"], AGGREGATES, true)) {
            $name = $this->take()["value"];
            $e = new Expr("aggregate", $name);
            $this->expect("(");
            if (!($name === "COUNT" && $this->accept("*"))) {
                $e->distinct = $this->accept("DISTINCT");
                $e->args = [$this->expression()];
            }
            $this->expect(")");
            return $e;
        }
        if ($this->accept("(")) {
            $e = $this->expression();
            $this->expect(")");
            return new Expr("group", "", [$e]);
        }
        $this->syntax();
    }
    private function clause(string $word): ?Expr
    {
        return $this->accept($word) ? $this->expression() : null;
    }
    private function item(): array
    {
        $start = $this->position;
        $e = $this->expression();
        $ts = array_slice($this->tokens, $start, $this->position - $start);
        $alias = $this->alias();
        $heading = $alias;
        if ($heading === null) {
            if ($e->kind === "ref") {
                $heading = $e->column;
            } else {
                $heading = "";
                foreach ($ts as $i => $t) {
                    if ($i > 0 && $t["kind"] !== "symbol" && $ts[$i - 1]["kind"] !== "symbol") {
                        $heading .= " ";
                    }
                    $heading .= $t["text"];
                }
            }
        }
        return ["expr" => $e, "alias" => $alias, "heading" => $heading];
    }
    private function orderItem(): array
    {
        $start = $this->position;
        $e = $this->expression();
        $single = $this->position === $start + 1;
        $t = $this->tokens[$start];
        $desc = $this->accept("DESC");
        if (!$desc) {
            $this->accept("ASC");
        }
        return [
            "expr" => $e,
            "desc" => $desc,
            "ordinal" => $single && $t["kind"] === "integer" ? $t["value"] : null,
            "alias" => $single && $t["kind"] === "name" ? $t["value"] : null,
        ];
    }
    private function query(): array
    {
        $q = [
            "kind" => "select",
            "distinct" => $this->accept("DISTINCT"),
            "star" => $this->accept("*"),
            "joins" => [],
            "group" => null,
            "order" => [],
            "limit" => null,
            "offset" => 0,
        ];
        $q["items"] = $q["star"] ? [] : $this->comma(fn() => $this->item());
        $this->expect("FROM");
        $q["source"] = $this->table();
        while ($this->at("JOIN") || $this->at("INNER") || $this->at("LEFT")) {
            $left = $this->accept("LEFT");
            if ($left) {
                $this->accept("OUTER");
            } else {
                $this->accept("INNER");
            }
            $this->expect("JOIN");
            $t = $this->table();
            $this->expect("ON");
            $q["joins"][] = ["table" => $t, "left" => $left, "condition" => $this->expression()];
        }
        $q["where"] = $this->clause("WHERE");
        if ($this->accept("GROUP")) {
            $this->expect("BY");
            $q["group"] = $this->comma(fn() => $this->reference());
        }
        $q["having"] = $this->clause("HAVING");
        if ($this->accept("ORDER")) {
            $this->expect("BY");
            $q["order"] = $this->comma(fn() => $this->orderItem());
        }
        if ($this->accept("LIMIT")) {
            $q["limit"] = $this->kind("integer");
            if ($this->accept("OFFSET")) {
                $q["offset"] = $this->kind("integer");
            }
        }
        return $q;
    }
    public function statement(): ?array
    {
        $s = null;
        if ($this->accept("CREATE")) {
            $this->expect("TABLE");
            $name = $this->kind("name");
            $columns = $this->parens(function () {
                $n = $this->kind("name");
                if (!$this->at("INT") && !$this->at("TEXT")) {
                    $this->syntax();
                }
                $type = $this->take()["value"];
                $pk = 0;
                $nn = false;
                while (true) {
                    if ($this->accept("PRIMARY")) {
                        $this->expect("KEY");
                        $pk++;
                        $nn = true;
                    } elseif ($this->accept("NOT")) {
                        $this->expect("NULL");
                        $nn = true;
                    } else {
                        break;
                    }
                }
                return ["name" => $n, "type" => $type, "primary" => $pk, "notNull" => $nn];
            });
            $s = ["kind" => "create", "name" => $name, "columns" => $columns];
        } elseif ($this->accept("DROP")) {
            $this->expect("TABLE");
            $s = ["kind" => "drop", "name" => $this->kind("name")];
        } elseif ($this->accept("INSERT")) {
            $this->expect("INTO");
            $name = $this->kind("name");
            $names = $this->at("(") ? $this->parens(fn() => $this->kind("name")) : null;
            $this->expect("VALUES");
            $s = [
                "kind" => "insert",
                "name" => $name,
                "names" => $names,
                "tuples" => $this->comma(fn() => $this->parens(fn() => $this->expression())),
            ];
        } elseif ($this->accept("UPDATE")) {
            $name = $this->kind("name");
            $this->expect("SET");
            $as = $this->comma(function () {
                $n = $this->kind("name");
                $this->expect("=");
                return [$n, $this->expression()];
            });
            $s = [
                "kind" => "update",
                "name" => $name,
                "assignments" => $as,
                "where" => $this->clause("WHERE"),
            ];
        } elseif ($this->accept("DELETE")) {
            $this->expect("FROM");
            $s = [
                "kind" => "delete",
                "name" => $this->kind("name"),
                "where" => $this->clause("WHERE"),
            ];
        } elseif ($this->accept("SELECT")) {
            $s = $this->query();
        } elseif ($this->accept("EXIT")) {
            $s = ["kind" => "exit"];
        }
        $this->expect(";");
        return $s;
    }
}
final class Table
{
    public array $rows = [];
    public function __construct(
        public string $name,
        public array $columns,
        public ?int $primary = null,
    ) {}
    public function column(string $name): ?int
    {
        foreach ($this->columns as $i => $c) {
            if ($c["name"] === $name) {
                return $i;
            }
        }
        return null;
    }
}
final class Scope
{
    public array $entries = [];
    public int $width = 0;
    public function add(string $name, Table $table): void
    {
        foreach ($this->entries as $entry) {
            if ($entry["name"] === $name) {
                fail("duplicate table name " . $name);
            }
        }
        $this->entries[] = ["name" => $name, "table" => $table, "offset" => $this->width];
        $this->width += count($table->columns);
    }
    public function resolve(Expr $e): string
    {
        $found = [];
        $seen = false;
        foreach ($this->entries as $entry) {
            if ($e->table === null || $e->table === $entry["name"]) {
                $seen = true;
                $i = $entry["table"]->column($e->column);
                if ($i !== null) {
                    $found[] = [$entry["offset"] + $i, $entry["table"]->columns[$i]["type"]];
                }
            }
        }
        if ($e->table !== null && !$seen) {
            fail("unknown table " . $e->table);
        }
        if (!$found) {
            fail("unknown column " . $e->text);
        }
        if (count($found) > 1) {
            fail("ambiguous column " . $e->column);
        }
        $e->index = $found[0][0];
        return $found[0][1];
    }
}
function compatible(string $a, string $b): bool
{
    return $a === $b || $a === "NULL" || $b === "NULL";
}
function requireType(string $a, string $b, string $op): void
{
    if (!compatible($a, $b)) {
        fail("type mismatch for " . $op);
    }
}
function check(
    Expr $e,
    Scope $scope,
    bool $allow = false,
    ?array $grouped = null,
    bool $inside = false,
): string {
    if ($e->kind === "literal") {
        return $e->value === null ? "NULL" : (is_int($e->value) ? "INT" : "TEXT");
    }
    if ($e->kind === "ref") {
        $t = $scope->resolve($e);
        if ($grouped !== null && !$inside && !in_array($e->index, $grouped, true)) {
            fail("column " . $e->text . " is not grouped");
        }
        return $t;
    }
    if ($e->kind === "aggregate") {
        if (!$allow || $inside) {
            fail("misuse of aggregate " . $e->op);
        }
        if (!$e->args) {
            return "INT";
        }
        $t = check($e->args[0], $scope, $allow, $grouped, true);
        if (in_array($e->op, ["SUM", "AVG"], true)) {
            requireType($t, "INT", $e->op);
        }
        return in_array($e->op, ["MIN", "MAX"], true) ? $t : "INT";
    }
    $types = [];
    foreach ($e->args as $a) {
        $types[] = check($a, $scope, $allow, $grouped, $inside);
    }
    if ($e->kind === "group") {
        return $types[0];
    }
    if ($e->kind === "isnull") {
        return "INT";
    }
    if ($e->kind === "binary" && in_array($e->op, COMPARISONS, true)) {
        requireType($types[0], $types[1], $e->op);
        return "INT";
    }
    if ($e->kind === "in" || $e->kind === "between") {
        foreach (array_slice($types, 1) as $t) {
            requireType($t, $types[0], $e->kind === "in" ? "IN" : "BETWEEN");
        }
        return "INT";
    }
    $op = $e->kind === "like" ? "LIKE" : $e->op;
    $type = in_array($op, ["LIKE", "||"], true) ? "TEXT" : "INT";
    foreach ($types as $t) {
        requireType($t, $type, $op);
    }
    return $op === "||" ? "TEXT" : "INT";
}
function condition(
    ?Expr $e,
    Scope $s,
    string $name,
    bool $allow = false,
    ?array $grouped = null,
): void {
    if ($e !== null) {
        requireType(check($e, $s, $allow, $grouped), "INT", $name);
    }
}
function hasAggregate(Expr $e): bool
{
    if ($e->kind === "aggregate") {
        return true;
    }
    foreach ($e->args as $a) {
        if (hasAggregate($a)) {
            return true;
        }
    }
    return false;
}
function truth(int|string|null $v): bool
{
    return $v !== null && $v !== 0;
}
function inverse(?int $v): ?int
{
    return $v === null ? null : ($v === 0 ? 1 : 0);
}
function operate(string $op, int|string|null $a, int|string|null $b): int|string|null
{
    if ($op === "AND") {
        return $a === 0 || $b === 0 ? 0 : ($a === null || $b === null ? null : 1);
    }
    if ($op === "OR") {
        return truth($a) || truth($b) ? 1 : ($a === null || $b === null ? null : 0);
    }
    if ($a === null || $b === null) {
        return null;
    }
    return match ($op) {
        "+" => $a + $b,
        "-" => $a - $b,
        "*" => $a * $b,
        "||" => $a . $b,
        "/" => $b === 0 ? null : intdiv($a, $b),
        "%" => $b === 0 ? null : $a - $b * intdiv($a, $b),
        "=" => $a === $b ? 1 : 0,
        "<>", "!=" => $a !== $b ? 1 : 0,
        "<" => compareValues($a, $b) < 0 ? 1 : 0,
        "<=" => compareValues($a, $b) <= 0 ? 1 : 0,
        ">" => compareValues($a, $b) > 0 ? 1 : 0,
        ">=" => compareValues($a, $b) >= 0 ? 1 : 0,
    };
}
function likeMatch(string $text, string $pattern): int
{
    $dp = array_fill(0, strlen($text) + 1, false);
    $dp[0] = true;
    for ($j = 0; $j < strlen($pattern); $j++) {
        $c = $pattern[$j];
        if ($c === "%") {
            for ($i = 1; $i <= strlen($text); $i++) {
                $dp[$i] = $dp[$i] || $dp[$i - 1];
            }
        } else {
            for ($i = strlen($text); $i > 0; $i--) {
                $dp[$i] = $dp[$i - 1] && ($c === "_" || $c === $text[$i - 1]);
            }
            $dp[0] = false;
        }
    }
    return $dp[strlen($text)] ? 1 : 0;
}
function evaluate(Expr $e, array $row, ?array $group = null): int|string|null
{
    if ($e->kind === "literal") {
        return $e->value;
    }
    if ($e->kind === "ref") {
        return $row[$e->index];
    }
    if ($e->kind === "aggregate") {
        if (!$e->args) {
            return count($group);
        }
        $values = [];
        foreach ($group as $r) {
            $v = evaluate($e->args[0], $r);
            if ($v !== null && (!$e->distinct || !in_array($v, $values, true))) {
                $values[] = $v;
            }
        }
        if ($e->op === "COUNT") {
            return count($values);
        }
        if (!$values) {
            return null;
        }
        return match ($e->op) {
            "SUM" => array_sum($values),
            "AVG" => intdiv(array_sum($values), count($values)),
            "MIN" => array_reduce(
                array_slice($values, 1),
                fn($a, $b) => compareValues($a, $b) <= 0 ? $a : $b,
                $values[0],
            ),
            "MAX" => array_reduce(
                array_slice($values, 1),
                fn($a, $b) => compareValues($a, $b) >= 0 ? $a : $b,
                $values[0],
            ),
        };
    }
    $a = [];
    foreach ($e->args as $arg) {
        $a[] = evaluate($arg, $row, $group);
    }
    if ($e->kind === "group") {
        return $a[0];
    }
    if ($e->kind === "unary") {
        return $e->op === "NOT" ? inverse($a[0]) : ($a[0] === null ? null : -$a[0]);
    }
    if ($e->kind === "binary") {
        return operate($e->op, $a[0], $a[1]);
    }
    if ($e->kind === "isnull") {
        return ($a[0] === null) !== $e->negated ? 1 : 0;
    }
    $result = match ($e->kind) {
        "in" => $a[0] === null
            ? null
            : (in_array($a[0], array_slice($a, 1), true)
                ? 1
                : (in_array(null, array_slice($a, 1), true)
                    ? null
                    : 0)),
        "between" => operate("AND", operate(">=", $a[0], $a[1]), operate("<=", $a[0], $a[2])),
        "like" => $a[0] === null || $a[1] === null ? null : likeMatch($a[0], $a[1]),
    };
    return $e->negated ? inverse($result) : $result;
}
function satisfies(?Expr $e, array $row, ?array $group = null): bool
{
    return $e === null || truth(evaluate($e, $row, $group));
}
function rowCount(int $n): string
{
    return $n . ($n === 1 ? " row" : " rows");
}
function written(int|string|null $v): string
{
    return $v === null ? "NULL" : (string) $v;
}
function compareValues(int|string|null $a, int|string|null $b): int
{
    if ($a === $b) {
        return 0;
    }
    if ($a === null) {
        return -1;
    }
    if ($b === null) {
        return 1;
    }
    return is_string($a) ? strcmp($a, $b) : $a <=> $b;
}
function printTable(array $items, array $types, array $rows): void
{
    $headings = array_column($items, "heading");
    $cells = array_map(fn($r) => array_map("written", $r), $rows);
    $widths = array_map("strlen", $headings);
    foreach ($cells as $r) {
        foreach ($r as $i => $v) {
            $widths[$i] = max($widths[$i], strlen($v));
        };
    }
    $sep = "+";
    foreach ($widths as $w) {
        $sep .= str_repeat("-", $w + 2) . "+";
    }
    $render = function ($row, $header) use ($widths, $types) {
        $s = "|";
        foreach ($row as $i => $v) {
            $s .=
                " " .
                str_pad(
                    $v,
                    $widths[$i],
                    " ",
                    !$header && $types[$i] === "INT" ? STR_PAD_LEFT : STR_PAD_RIGHT,
                ) .
                " |";
        }
        return $s;
    };
    echo $sep, "\n", $render($headings, true), "\n", $sep, "\n";
    foreach ($cells as $r) {
        echo $render($r, false), "\n";
    }
    echo $sep, "\n(", rowCount(count($rows)), ")\n";
}
final class Database
{
    private array $tables = [];
    private function table(string $name): Table
    {
        if (!isset($this->tables[$name])) {
            fail("unknown table " . $name);
        }
        return $this->tables[$name];
    }
    private function targets(Table $t, array $names): array
    {
        $result = [];
        foreach ($names as $n) {
            $i = $t->column($n);
            if ($i === null) {
                fail("unknown column " . $n);
            }
            if (in_array($i, $result, true)) {
                fail("duplicate column " . $n);
            }
            $result[] = $i;
        }
        return $result;
    }
    private function constraints(Table $t, array $rows, array $checked): void
    {
        foreach ($checked as $i) {
            foreach ($t->columns as $j => $c) {
                if ($c["notNull"] && $rows[$i][$j] === null) {
                    fail("NULL value in column " . $c["name"]);
                }
            }
            if ($t->primary !== null) {
                foreach ($rows as $j => $r) {
                    if ($i !== $j && $r[$t->primary] === $rows[$i][$t->primary]) {
                        fail("duplicate primary key " . written($r[$t->primary]));
                    }
                };
            }
        }
    }
    public function execute(array $s): void
    {
        if ($s["kind"] === "select") {
            $this->select($s);
            return;
        }
        if ($s["kind"] === "create") {
            if (isset($this->tables[$s["name"]])) {
                fail("table " . $s["name"] . " already exists");
            }
            $seen = [];
            $primary = 0;
            $key = null;
            foreach ($s["columns"] as $i => $c) {
                if (isset($seen[$c["name"]])) {
                    fail("duplicate column " . $c["name"]);
                }
                $seen[$c["name"]] = true;
                $primary += $c["primary"];
                if ($primary >= 2) {
                    fail("multiple primary keys");
                }
                if ($c["primary"] > 0) {
                    $key = $i;
                }
            }
            $this->tables[$s["name"]] = new Table($s["name"], $s["columns"], $key);
            echo "Table ", $s["name"], " created.\n";
            return;
        }
        $t = $this->table($s["name"]);
        if ($s["kind"] === "drop") {
            unset($this->tables[$s["name"]]);
            echo "Table ", $s["name"], " dropped.\n";
            return;
        }
        $rows = [];
        $checked = [];
        $count = 0;
        if ($s["kind"] === "insert") {
            $targets =
                $s["names"] === null ? array_keys($t->columns) : $this->targets($t, $s["names"]);
            foreach ($s["tuples"] as $tuple) {
                if (count($tuple) !== count($targets)) {
                    fail("expected " . count($targets) . " values, got " . count($tuple));
                }
                foreach ($tuple as $i => $e) {
                    $c = $t->columns[$targets[$i]];
                    requireType(check($e, new Scope()), $c["type"], "column " . $c["name"]);
                }
            }
            $rows = $t->rows;
            foreach ($s["tuples"] as $tuple) {
                $row = array_fill(0, count($t->columns), null);
                foreach ($tuple as $i => $e) {
                    $row[$targets[$i]] = evaluate($e, []);
                }
                $checked[] = count($rows);
                $rows[] = $row;
            }
            $this->constraints($t, $rows, $checked);
            $count = count($s["tuples"]);
        } elseif ($s["kind"] === "update") {
            $targets = $this->targets($t, array_column($s["assignments"], 0));
            $scope = new Scope();
            $scope->add($t->name, $t);
            foreach ($s["assignments"] as $i => $a) {
                $c = $t->columns[$targets[$i]];
                requireType(check($a[1], $scope), $c["type"], "column " . $c["name"]);
            }
            condition($s["where"], $scope, "WHERE");
            foreach ($t->rows as $i => $row) {
                $next = $row;
                if (satisfies($s["where"], $row)) {
                    foreach ($s["assignments"] as $j => $a) {
                        $next[$targets[$j]] = evaluate($a[1], $row);
                    }
                    $checked[] = $i;
                    $count++;
                }
                $rows[] = $next;
            }
            $this->constraints($t, $rows, $checked);
        } else {
            $scope = new Scope();
            $scope->add($t->name, $t);
            condition($s["where"], $scope, "WHERE");
            foreach ($t->rows as $row) {
                if (satisfies($s["where"], $row)) {
                    $count++;
                } else {
                    $rows[] = $row;
                }
            }
        }
        $t->rows = $rows;
        echo rowCount($count),
            match ($s["kind"]) {
                "insert" => " inserted.",
                "update" => " updated.",
                "delete" => " deleted.",
            },
            "\n";
    }
    private function select(array $q): void
    {
        $scope = new Scope();
        $scope->add($q["source"]["alias"], $this->table($q["source"]["name"]));
        foreach ($q["joins"] as $j) {
            $scope->add($j["table"]["alias"], $this->table($j["table"]["name"]));
            condition($j["condition"], $scope, "ON");
        }
        condition($q["where"], $scope, "WHERE");
        $grouping = [];
        foreach ($q["group"] ?? [] as $ref) {
            $scope->resolve($ref);
            $grouping[] = $ref->index;
        }
        $items = $q["items"];
        if ($q["star"]) {
            foreach ($scope->entries as $entry) {
                foreach ($entry["table"]->columns as $c) {
                    $e = new Expr("ref");
                    $e->table = $entry["name"];
                    $e->column = $e->text = $c["name"];
                    $items[] = ["expr" => $e, "heading" => $c["name"], "alias" => null];
                };
            };
        }
        $aggregate = $q["group"] !== null || $q["having"] !== null;
        foreach ([...$items, ...$q["order"]] as $i) {
            $aggregate = $aggregate || hasAggregate($i["expr"]);
        }
        $grouped = $aggregate ? $grouping : null;
        $types = [];
        foreach ($items as $i) {
            $types[] = check($i["expr"], $scope, true, $grouped);
        }
        condition($q["having"], $scope, "HAVING", true, $grouped);
        $keys = [];
        foreach ($q["order"] as $o) {
            $key = null;
            if ($o["ordinal"] !== null) {
                $k = $o["ordinal"];
                if ($k < 1 || $k > count($items)) {
                    fail("ORDER BY position " . $k . " is out of range");
                }
                $key = $items[$k - 1]["expr"];
            } elseif ($o["alias"] !== null) {
                foreach ($items as $i) {
                    if ($i["alias"] === $o["alias"]) {
                        $key = $i["expr"];
                        break;
                    }
                };
            }
            if ($key === null) {
                check($o["expr"], $scope, true, $grouped);
                $key = $o["expr"];
            }
            $keys[] = $key;
        }
        $rows = $scope->entries[0]["table"]->rows;
        foreach ($q["joins"] as $ji => $join) {
            $t = $scope->entries[$ji + 1]["table"];
            $next = [];
            foreach ($rows as $left) {
                $found = false;
                foreach ($t->rows as $right) {
                    $combined = [...$left, ...$right];
                    if (satisfies($join["condition"], $combined)) {
                        $next[] = $combined;
                        $found = true;
                    }
                }
                if ($join["left"] && !$found) {
                    $next[] = [...$left, ...array_fill(0, count($t->columns), null)];
                }
            }
            $rows = $next;
        }
        $rows = array_values(array_filter($rows, fn($r) => satisfies($q["where"], $r)));
        $groups = [];
        if (!$aggregate) {
            foreach ($rows as $r) {
                $groups[] = [$r];
            };
        } elseif ($q["group"] === null) {
            $groups = [$rows];
        } else {
            $groupKeys = [];
            foreach ($rows as $r) {
                $key = array_map(fn($i) => $r[$i], $grouping);
                $at = array_search($key, $groupKeys, true);
                if ($at === false) {
                    $at = count($groups);
                    $groups[] = [];
                    $groupKeys[] = $key;
                }
                $groups[$at][] = $r;
            }
        }
        $results = [];
        foreach ($groups as $g) {
            $row = $g[0] ?? [];
            $context = $aggregate ? $g : null;
            if (!satisfies($q["having"], $row, $context)) {
                continue;
            }
            $values = [];
            $sort = [];
            foreach ($items as $i) {
                $values[] = evaluate($i["expr"], $row, $context);
            }
            foreach ($keys as $key) {
                $sort[] = evaluate($key, $row, $context);
            }
            $results[] = ["values" => $values, "keys" => $sort, "position" => count($results)];
        }
        usort($results, function ($a, $b) use ($q) {
            foreach ($q["order"] as $i => $o) {
                $c = compareValues($a["keys"][$i], $b["keys"][$i]);
                if ($c !== 0) {
                    return $o["desc"] ? -$c : $c;
                }
            }
            return $a["position"] <=> $b["position"];
        });
        $unique = [];
        foreach ($results as $r) {
            if (!$q["distinct"] || !in_array($r["values"], $unique, true)) {
                $unique[] = $r["values"];
            }
        }
        $rows = array_slice($unique, $q["offset"], $q["limit"]);
        printTable($items, $types, $rows);
    }
}
$source = stream_get_contents(STDIN);
$start = 0;
$segments = [];
for ($i = 0; $i < strlen($source); $i++) {
    if ($source[$i] === "'") {
        $i = strpos($source, "'", $i + 1);
    } elseif (substr($source, $i, 2) === "--") {
        $end = strpos($source, "\n", $i);
        $i = $end === false ? strlen($source) : $end;
    } elseif ($source[$i] === ";") {
        $segments[] = substr($source, $start, $i - $start + 1);
        $start = $i + 1;
    }
}
$db = new Database();
foreach ($segments as $text) {
    try {
        $s = new Parser(tokenize($text))->statement();
        if ($s !== null && $s["kind"] === "exit") {
            break;
        }
        if ($s !== null) {
            $db->execute($s);
        }
    } catch (SqlError $err) {
        echo "ERROR: ", $err->getMessage(), "\n";
    }
